title: Author tests for ProjectHub visibility regressions and unsafe auxiliary surfaces

ground_truth_issues.description: A test verifies an expired or unaccepted delegated access grant cannot let a participant read seeded cross-boundary project data, and asserts the serialized response does not contain a seeded cross-boundary project marker.
A test verifies an ordinary authenticated participant cannot retrieve seeded operational configuration data, and asserts the serialized response does not contain a seeded secret configuration marker.
A test serializes a participant readback response for seeded cross-boundary project data and asserts the outcome does not contain a seeded cross-boundary project marker.
A test serializes participant project discovery results for seeded cross-boundary data and asserts the results do not contain a seeded cross-boundary project marker.
A test serializes participant task search results for seeded cross-boundary data and asserts the results do not contain a seeded cross-boundary task marker.
A test serializes a participant project readback response for same-boundary data and asserts it does not contain a seeded privileged project marker.
A test serializes participant comment readback for seeded same-boundary task data and asserts the response does not contain a seeded internal comment marker.
A test verifies a participant can read seeded same-boundary project data and asserts the response contains a seeded same-boundary project marker.
A test verifies participant search for seeded same-boundary task data still returns the seeded same-boundary task marker.
A test verifies admin readback of seeded cross-boundary project data returns a seeded privileged project marker.
A test verifies admin readback of seeded cross-boundary task data returns a seeded privileged task marker.
The submitted tests are executable pytest tests that use the provided Flask test client or fixtures and include concrete assertions against response status or serialized response content.
At least one test isolates state by creating fresh resources with unique sentinel markers and asserts that results do not depend on data created by other tests.
